versions.localizedDescription:
• Local story seen out of expermint now fully stable
- Local story seen, View stories without notifying the recipient or sending view activity to Instagram servers

• Feed Grid & list View.
• Fake location.

• Confirmation prompts before liking, commenting, calling, or reposting.
• And many more settings...
